# `gmail-read-inbox`
- **Version:** 1.0.0

Fetch Gmail into the payload tracker.py collect consumes.


- **Usage:** `gmail-read-inbox [FLAGS]`

## Flags
- **`--label <label>`** — Fetch only this label (validated against Gmail labels)
- **`--since <date>`** — Lookback start date, YYYY-MM-DD
- **`--max <max>`** — Total messages to collect, fetched 50 at a time
- **`--inbox <file>`** — Inbox payload path
- **`--labels-out <file>`** — Complete Gmail label inventory path
- **`--job-labels-out <file>`** — Cached JOB-label hierarchy path
- **`--timeout <timeout>`** — Timeout in seconds per Composio API call (default: 60)
- **`-v --verbose`** — Print detailed progress and timing to stderr
- **`--dry-run`** — Read Gmail and compare labels, but write nothing
